featured_reviews.review_text:
This Treatment almost killed me. Here's my story :

I am from Bangalore and have been suffering from Lichen Planus for the past 15 years. After loosing to allopathy treatment , I contacted Dr Raj as a last resort to treat my condition. Here's where the problem starts. When I contacted the clinic, one madam answered my call, heard my problem out and then asked me to deposit 16000 as treatment charges and also arranged for a video call with Dr raj. The video call was very grainy as it was when the doctor was travelling to some place. I still put my faith in him and paid the entire amount and went ahead with the treatment. This madam told me that she will be my in-charge until the end of the treatment but she has no time to answer your calls. She's always so so busy. As a long distance patient its so frustrating because in this treatment your are bound to have 1000s of doubts regarding medication, diet etc. But the madam is always busy. She will then suddenly respond after 3-4 hours, that too over whatsapp. Moving on, the medicines arrive after a lot of follow-up. But there is no prescription. Have you ever seen a doctor give you so many medicines and no prescription. Its so funny and baffling. Again after a lot of follow-ups , I got the details of medicines. The 1st 14 days was panchakarma treatment. I had no fruits, 80% of vegetables cut down, no curds, no milk, no idli, everything cooked in ghee. It was a very restrictive diet. The medicines were very very very difficult to consume.  It was so depressing. I still went ahead and finished the 14 days panchakarma. My face turned very pale. Everyone started asking me the reasons. I thought it was the diet and went ahead. another 14 days of the diet and tons of medicines. One fine day I wake up to a severe headache. It was like my nerves would burst. Went to my general physician. Guess what had happened ?? Something that never ever happened in my 35 years of life : Hemoglobin down from 14 to 8, Thyroid up from 5 to 14, Vitamin B12 and D3 deficient.  All my vitals screwed because of my restrictive diet. I had weird pains in my chest and head. Got my tmt, echo and brain MRI scan. I was admitted to the hospital and had take injections for a week.
Conclusion : This is an absolutely impractical diet, with tons of medicines. Also the madam is absolutely in-cooperative. From a very healthy man, I turned anemic and now have to battle my high thyroid levels. Dr raj, because of whom you may take up the treatment will meet you for 15 mins and then will vanish forever. I Would give them Zero stars if I could. An absolute trap from people trying to find solutions for their suffering.
PLEASE STAY AWAY AND FIND A SCIENTIFIC APPROACH TO YOUR PROBLEM. THEY HAVE NOTHING TO SAVE YOUR FROM YOUR CONDITION.

My mother, who is 60 years old, visited Ayushakti Ayurved Health Centre in Dadar West for knee pain treatment. Their doctor told us that the fluid in her knee (joint effusion) would return to normal and the pain would go away after treatment. They charged around ₹70,000 and asked us to take X-rays before and after the treatment to show the “improvement.”

For one month, they advised her to stop eating non-veg food and even restricted some veg food without any reason or alternatives.How can patient eat moong all days?

After one month, my mother took another X-ray, but there was absolutely no improvement. We then decided to take a second opinion from an orthopedic doctor. After checking both the “before” and “after” X-rays, the doctor explained that the clinic had asked for different X-ray angles/views, which can naturally make the images look different even without any actual improvement. He said this is a common way to mislead patients.

The worst part was that after paying such a huge amount, we couldn’t even question them properly. Whenever we asked anything, they gave scripted answers like, “You have to trust our medication.”

In my personal experience, this treatment was a complete waste of money. If you have plenty of money, you can try it at your own risk. But if you don’t want to waste your hard-earned money, please think carefully before going ahead.

God bless you if you are reading this after already making the payment.
